summary: Stridebook is a running log for runners who already track their runs — and want a proper training diary to go with them.
features: Weekly distance against last week and your weekly goal
Your week starts on the day you choose, so every run lands in the right week
A seven-day strip that shows each run — and why you didn't run (rest, sick, injured, travel, cross-training)
Twelve-week chart and your longest run
Distance, time, pace, run type, effort, route and notes
Notes for days without a run
Distance on every pair, with a retirement reminder
